dataLocations.description: Marchetti et al.: Spike time dependent plasticity (STDP) data from neonate C57BL/6 (wild-type) mice, negative pairing (dataset version fc79175a-e044-4377-83ce-3401a9046f1a). Six dataset versions share the bucket p63ea6-hbp-00005, one folder each; this one is MF-CA3-STDP-neonate-WT-negPairing/. The data descriptor: 'File names ending with _C.txt are recordings in control conditions, those ending with _P.txt are recordings during and after pairing.' Every entry below the dataset's folder was listed.
